description: This file defines internal benchmarking functions and types for measuring performance of functions with a single integer argument, including timing, variability estimation, and thread pinning, within the Abseil C++ library.

methods.name: PinThreadToCPU
methods.description: Pins the current thread to a specified CPU core to reduce measurement noise.

methods.name: InvariantTicksPerSecond
methods.description: Returns the tick rate for converting measurement ticks to seconds.

methods.name: Measure
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a function with given inputs, returning performance results.

methods.name: CallClosure
methods.description: Invokes a lambda or function object with a given input.

methods.name: MeasureClosure
methods.description: Measures a lambda function with captures, wrapping around the Measure function.
